correctness.rationale: The geometric mass of periodic residues is exactly q_R(r)=sum_{j in R}r^j/sum_{j=0}^{k-1}r^j. The block mass follows f(x)=ax²+2bx(1-x)+c(1-x)² and its fixed-point discriminant is Delta=1+4(b²-b+c(1-a)). Reconstructed fixed point multiplier 1-sqrt(Delta), two-cycle multiplier 5-Delta and the sharp upper envelope sup Delta=5-4m_R (unattained). Strict boundary Delta<4 when m_R>=1/4 and open-region Delta>4 when m_R<1/4. Total-variation Lipschitz lift follows finite mixture continuity. Initial contiguous residue block has monotone mass and inf=m/k; exact Fraction check for R={0,11,12,13} mod 14 yields a≈0.2376252658566 and Delta≈4.0439781871. General one-dimensional quadratic convergence is a published premise; accessible source extraction of its theorem was incomplete, but the multiplier and fixed/two-cycle algebra were reconstructed independently.
